title: OutputDistinctValuesResponse
description: Response for GET /api/outputs/:id/distinct-values?column= (HEL-1188). The named `column` is refused with a defined 400 (naming the column) unless it is currently reported eq/in-eligible by GET /api/outputs/:id/filter-capabilities for this same Output. On success, `values` carries that column's distinct non-null values across the Output's node_snapshots data, each paired with its occurrence count, ordered by occurrence count descending, capped at the same bound filter-capabilities uses to decide eq/in eligibility (see openspec/specs/output-routes-api/spec.md).
